usedFor: HelloLeads CRM tracks leads, and Google Drive copies a file when “When Lead Becomes Customer” runs “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “When Lead Becomes Customer” in HelloLeads CRM, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A won lead gets its own copy of a contract or welcome file, with a new name.

watchOut: “When Lead Becomes Customer” is polling, so the copy appears after a scheduled check.
